The Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Bundle includes Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN for one price. Interested in bundling your subscriptions? Find all the details you need to get started.

Disney+: Watch all your favorite movies and TV shows from Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, and National Geographic. From new releases to your favorite classics and exclusive Originals, there's something for everyone.

Hulu: Watch on-demand shows and movies, including full seasons of exclusive series, current TV hits, past seasons, movies, Hulu Originals, kids shows, and more. Bundle subscribers can stream Hulu content directly on the Hulu app or website, in addition to select content available through Hulu via the Disney+ app or website.

ESPN Select: With an ESPN Select subscription, you can expect to see content from the ESPN+ library. Watch thousands of live sporting events, the complete 30 for 30 library, and on-demand sports content that includes games, news highlights, ESPN Originals and more. You can stream directly on the ESPN app or access content on the Disney+ and Hulu apps.*

ESPN Unlimited: Watch everything included with ESPN Select, plus live access to all of ESPN’s networks and services – including ESPN and ESPN 2 – in addition to ESPN on ABC sporting events. You can stream directly on the ESPN app or access content on the Disney+ and Hulu apps.*

*Some ESPN content can only be accessed on the ESPN app and as such may not be available on the Disney+ or Hulu apps.

Disney+ Price Increase: Ad-Free Plans Rise to $21.49 as Disney Pushes Subscribers to Ads | AlphaPilot

# Disney+ Price Increase: Ad-Free Plans Rise to $21.49 as Disney Pushes Subscribers to Ads

By: AlphaPilot Editorial Team Updated on 2026-09-24

Disney raised prices on nearly every U.S. Disney+ and Hulu plan effective Wednesday, September 23, 2026, with the ad-free tiers taking the biggest hit. Disney+ Premium and Hulu Premium each rose $2.50 to $21.49 a month; the ad-free Disney+/Hulu bundle went up $2 to $21.99; and the ad-supported standalone plans rose 50 cents to $12.49, while the ad-supported Disney+/Hulu bundle stayed flat at $12.99. New subscribers pay the new rates immediately, while existing subscribers were notified on Wednesday and will see the increase on their next billing cycle. The move is the latest in a cadence that has left Disney's ad-free tier nearly double its 2023 price, though still below the ad-free premiums charged by Netflix and Max. benzinga cnn.com tvline.com

## The full new price matrix

The increases, first reported by Bloomberg and confirmed across outlets, reset the U.S. menu as follows: Disney+ Premium (no ads) from $18.99 to $21.49; Hulu Premium (no ads) from $18.99 to $21.49; the Disney+/Hulu Premium bundle from $19.99 to $21.99; Disney+ with ads and Hulu with ads each from $11.99 to $12.49; and the Disney+/Hulu bundle with ads unchanged at $12.99. Disney also repriced several larger bundles and its live-TV service: the ad-supported Disney+, Hulu and ESPN Select bundle rises $2 to $21.99, the ad-free version rises $3 to $32.99, and Hulu + Live TV's entry plan now starts at $99.99 a month, up $10. tvline.com benzinga thewrap.com

## A price structure built to steer subscribers toward ads

The percentage math shows where Disney's pricing strategy is aimed. The ad-free standalone tiers absorbed a 13% increase ($2.50 on $18.99), while the ad-supported standalones rose just over 4% (50 cents on $11.99) and the ad-supported bundle was frozen entirely. Business Insider reports that Disney and Netflix have both raised ad-supported prices more gradually, reasoning they can generate more incremental revenue from those subscribers, and Morningstar's coverage notes the flat-priced ad-supported bundle is Disney's most popular offering. The through-line — and this is interpretation, not company guidance — is that Disney is deliberately pricing ad-free experiences at a premium to migrate price-sensitive households toward ad tiers that monetize each subscriber through advertising revenue in addition to the monthly fee, a model that sits behind Disney's push to streaming profitability. businessinsider.com morningstar.com cnn.com

## Bundling gets cheaper by comparison

The new pricing makes Disney's bundles look increasingly attractive relative to à-la-carte subscriptions. The Disney+/Hulu Premium bundle costs $21.99 — just 50 cents more than either service alone and roughly $21 less than buying Disney+ Premium and Hulu Premium separately at $42.98 combined. Bloomberg's reporting notes that Disney, like other operators, prices bundled plans attractively because consumers are less likely to cancel when they get access to multiple services in one bill. benzinga tvline.com detroitnews.com

## Still cheaper than Netflix and Max

Even at $21.49, Disney+ Premium undercuts its two biggest ad-free competitors. Netflix's top ad-free plan, which includes 4K and multi-device access, runs $26.99 a month, and Max's ad-free Premium tier is $22.99, per Warner Bros. Discovery's own pricing pages. Bloomberg framed Disney's increase as bringing its premium product more in line with Netflix's comparable tier, but the roughly $5.50 gap to Netflix and the $1.50 gap to Max suggest Disney still holds pricing headroom as the sector's ad-free plans converge on the $20-and-up range. detroitnews.com help.hbomax.com

Disney+ and Hulu Prices Rose in the U.S. — What Each Plan Costs Now | RED REACTIONS

# Disney+ and Hulu Prices Rose in the U.S. — What Each Plan Costs Now

Disney+ and Hulu's U.S. ad-free plans now cost $21.49 a month. Compare September 2026 standalone and bundle prices, unchanged tiers, promotions and billing timing.

SA By Sara Avegaard Published September 24, 2026 at 7:08 PM CEST 3 min read

Official Hulu on Disney+ logo showing both streaming brands together. Disney+ Press

Disney+ and Hulu’s U.S. standalone plans now cost $12.49 a month with ads or $21.49 a month for Premium. The ad-free price is $2.50 higher than before; the ad-supported price is up 50 cents. The Disney+/Hulu bundle with ads remains $12.99 a month, while its Premium bundle rose to $21.99. New subscriber prices took effect September 23, 2026. Existing subscribers see the change on their next monthly bill, according to TheWrap’s price-change report.

These are standard U.S. monthly prices, before tax or any eligibility-limited offer. Disney currently advertises lower six-month introductory prices for some bundles; those offers renew at the regular rates shown below.

## What Changed in September 2026?

| U.S. plan | Previous monthly price | Current monthly price | Change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Disney+ with ads | $11.99 | $12.49 | +$0.50 |
| Disney+ Premium | $18.99 | $21.49 | +$2.50 |
| Hulu with ads | $11.99 | $12.49 | +$0.50 |
| Hulu Premium | $18.99 | $21.49 | +$2.50 |
| Disney+ + Hulu with ads | $12.99 | $12.99 | No change |
| Disney+ + Hulu Premium | $19.99 | $21.99 | +$2.00 |
| Disney+ + Hulu + ESPN Select with ads | $19.99 | $21.99 | +$2.00 |
| Disney+ + Hulu + ESPN Select Premium | $29.99 | $32.99 | +$3.00 |

The current rates come from Disney’s plan listings and Hulu. Previous rates and the timing of the increase come from contemporaneous reporting. Disney+ Premium also has a current $214.99 annual option; the table compares monthly plans only.

## Which Bundles Stayed the Same?

Disney’s current site still lists Disney+ + Hulu + ESPN Unlimited at $35.99 a month with ads on Disney+ and Hulu, and $44.99 for the Premium Disney+/Hulu combination. Both Unlimited bundle prices were unchanged in the September price-change reporting. ESPN Select and Unlimited are different plans; do not compare their prices as if they contain the same sports access.

The Disney+/Hulu bundle with ads also stayed at $12.99. That is just 50 cents more than either ad-supported service alone at $12.49. The Premium duo at $21.99 is likewise 50 cents more than either $21.49 standalone Premium plan. That is a price comparison, not a claim that every viewer needs both services.

## What About HBO Max and Live TV?

Disney currently lists its Disney+ + Hulu + HBO Max bundle at $21.99 a month with ads or $34.99 without ads. Its Hulu + Live TV package, which includes Disney+ and ESPN Select, is $99.99 a month; the Premium Live TV combination is $109.99. Check the exact included services and any trial or promotion at checkout, because these are different packages from the two-service bundles above.

## When Will Existing Subscribers Pay More?

The September 23 rates applied to new U.S. sign-ups immediately. Existing monthly subscribers do not all get charged on the announcement date: the higher amount appears on their next billing cycle. Check your own account notice and renewal date for the precise charge. These prices do not describe Disney+ or Hulu subscriptions outside the U.S.

Disney’s current bundle page also offers eligible customers six months of the Disney+/Hulu ad-supported duo at $11.99 a month or the Premium duo at $19.99 a month, billed for the full six-month term. After that, they renew at $12.99 and $21.99 a month respectively. Those temporary prices are not the new standard rates.

For another recent streaming-price comparison, see what changed for Apple TV subscribers.
